features:
Key Features:

Made with 100% whole grain oats.

Filled with creamy peanut butter between two crunchy biscuits.

No artificial flavors, colors, or high-fructose corn syrup.

Each pouch contains one individually wrapped sandwich.

Benefits:

Great source of whole grains – about 14g per serving.

Satisfying texture – crunchy outside with creamy inside.

Good energy boost – contains carbs, fats, and protein to help keep you full.

Convenient – ideal for on-the-go snacking or a quick breakfast.

Balanced flavor – peanut butter provides richness without being overly sweet.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Peanut Butter (peanuts, salt), Canola Oil, Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Whole Grain Barley Flakes, Corn Starch, Peanut Flour, Honey, Salt, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor.
